packages.name: pcalg
packages.category: Constraint/equivalence/effect-set toolkit; aliases here are algorithms, not separate packages
packages.returned_object: CPDAG/PAG as appropriate; IDA multiset under its model
packages.candidate_use: Propose a narrow R discovery/IDA adapter; keep latent and interventional methods in their own cells
packages.conditions: Pin test and alpha; wrapper aborts on missing CI tests; preserve orientation conflicts and equivalence; no financial effect from PC alone

packages.name: bnlearn
packages.category: One package exposing constraint, score, hybrid and functional routes
packages.returned_object: BN/partially directed structure; parameters and causal queries are separate operations
packages.candidate_use: Alternative R baseline across supported data types; do not port all algorithms
packages.conditions: Make defaults/restarts/caps/missing-data subsets explicit; distinguish assumed causal BN from discovered identification; LiNGAM functional assumptions differ

packages.name: BCDAG
packages.category: Bayesian Gaussian observational DAG and joint-effect posterior
packages.returned_object: Graph/parameter draws, edge probabilities, MAP/MPM summaries, effect draws and credible intervals
packages.conditions: Record graph/parameter priors, S/burn/seeds/chains; fast=false baseline; reject silent posterior-to-confidence relabeling; review parameter validation and parm-specific interval source before use

packages.name: BiDAG
packages.category: Bayesian structure-search/sampling family; pcalg is a dependency, not an alias
packages.returned_object: MAP or sampled DAGs under declared score, search space and sampling configuration
packages.candidate_use: Reference and optional structure sensitivity comparator
packages.conditions: Retain score, search-space mask, parent limits, plus1 expansion and diagnostics; do not transfer Gaussian/discrete structure results to longitudinal causal claims

packages.name: mcmcabn
packages.category: Score-cache structural sampler; abn is a scoring dependency, not a duplicate sampler
packages.returned_object: Sampled DAGs and structural query frequencies
packages.candidate_use: Defer adapter; retain mixed-distribution and explicit-prior alternative in the comparison
packages.conditions: Resolve documented matrix-orientation conflict using named-node source/runtime oracle; freeze abn score cache and priors; do not convert structural frequency to an intervention effect

stopping_rule: Inspect the two inherited R seeds, all ten saved first-page metadata identities, BCDAG primary evidence, and its two explicitly named R package alternatives. Stop after that one package-reference hop. Log second-hop/methodology leads; do not infer complete coverage or unsupported absence.
